subject.title: Feature: Talk Mode Idle Timeout / Auto-Deactivation After Voice Wake

question: What public Talk idle-timeout contract should OpenClaw support for deactivating inactive Talk sessions after Voice Wake starts them?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear from source, but the fix adds public lifecycle and config behavior that affects Talk semantics across clients.

options.title: Approve additive Talk idle timeout
options.body: Add a canonical Talk config field with explicit units, limits, disabled behavior, and reset events, then wire it through config, protocol, docs, and macOS runtime.

options.title: Scope to Voice Wake-started sessions
options.body: Track activation source and auto-deactivate only sessions started from Voice Wake, leaving manually started Talk sessions unchanged.

options.title: Defer to broader voice lifecycle design
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers design idle behavior across native, realtime, and mobile Talk surfaces together.

recommendation.title: Approve additive Talk idle timeout
recommendation.body: Add a canonical Talk config field with explicit units, limits, disabled behavior, and reset events, then wire it through config, protocol, docs, and macOS runtime.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on Talk config/runtime defaults and repository config policy among the inspected paths.
